data.narrative:
Atlas Motion is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by experienced operators from Shield AI and Mach Industries, having raised $11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though the narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier proved insufficient for robust median-based triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $11.5M capital raised, yielding an implied valuation of $29M. This approach reflects typical venture step-ups from Seed to next-stage financing. Peer-median analysis was inapplicable: while 10 robotics and manufacturing companies exist in the broader dataset, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers produced fewer than three datapoints, rendering sector-specific multiples unreliable without material risk of false precision.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median point of $29M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of transaction comparables at identical stage within the narrow robotics subsector, reliance on a single methodological pillar, and limited visibility into Atlas Motion's current burn rate and runway relative to next funding milestone. The triangulation would strengthen materially with additional Seed-stage exits or Series A transactions in robotics manufacturing automation.
